Valkyrie Heavy Industries opted for heavy layered composite alloy armor, heavy diesel-fusion thermal turbines, and high-caliber rifled ballistics capable of holding entrenched ground redoubts under continuous orbital bombardments.
ms_prewar_hephaestus_avatar.manufacturing_quirks: Heavy frontal armor plates cause chronic stress fractures on forward knee actuator bearings during high-g descent landings; maintenance crews routinely reinforce the limb pins with field-welded tungsten rods.
ms_prewar_hephaestus_avatar.battlefield_reputation: Opposing Colony skirmishers mock its sluggish ground pace until its 120mm solid shot punches through their light aerosteel bulkheads at extreme ranges.
ms_prewar_hephaestus_avatar.doctrine_summary: Autonomous Flagship Escort doctrine tailored for faction_a strategic objectives.

ms_prewar_chronos_proto.name: Pre-War Chronos Vector
ms_prewar_chronos_proto.lore: Pre-war prototype harnessing compressed tachyon fields for near-instantaneous evasive maneuvers.
ms_prewar_chronos_proto.historical_lore: Pre-War Chronos Vector was manufactured by Pre-War Sol Arsenal to fill the critical role of Lost-Tech Tachyon Skirmisher. Born from Selene Vector Laboratories as a high-speed skirmishing doctrine. The design prioritizes particle beam efficiency and rapid heat dissipation, allowing it to harass enemy capital formations from beyond counter-battery range.
ms_prewar_chronos_proto.manufacturing_quirks: The lightweight aerosteel chassis is prone to micro-fracturing under high atmospheric drag; pilots must disengage limiter clamps before attempting high-speed atmospheric dives.
ms_prewar_chronos_proto.battlefield_reputation: Mercenaries love its high salvage value; black market cartels pay top dollar for intact Astraea superconducting capacitor banks and vernier nozzles.
ms_prewar_chronos_proto.doctrine_summary: Lost-Tech Tachyon Skirmisher doctrine tailored for faction_b strategic objectives.

ms_valkyrie_titan_juggernaut.name: VHD-X01 Juggernaut Prime
ms_valkyrie_titan_juggernaut.lore: Terrifying 100-ton superheavy walking fortress armed with quad synchronized 140mm autocannons.
ms_valkyrie_titan_juggernaut.historical_lore: VHD-X01 Juggernaut Prime was manufactured by Valkyrie Heavy Industries to fill the critical role of 100t Superheavy Bastion. Developed at the Lake Baikal metallurgical complex during the height of the Lunar border disputes. Its structural design emphasizes sheer mass and redundant hydraulic circuitry, ensuring the machine remains operational even after catastrophic armor breaches across secondary limbs.
ms_valkyrie_titan_juggernaut.manufacturing_quirks: Recoil forces from the primary heavy cannon shake loose cabin telemetry wiring harnesses; pilots are taught to kick the lower dashboard console to reset failing sensor readouts.
ms_valkyrie_titan_juggernaut.battlefield_reputation: Opposing Colony skirmishers mock its sluggish ground pace until its 120mm solid shot punches through their light aerosteel bulkheads at extreme ranges.
ms_valkyrie_titan_juggernaut.doctrine_summary: 100t Superheavy Bastion doctrine tailored for faction_a strategic objectives.

ms_rebel_partisan_guerilla.name: Frontier Militia Partisan
ms_rebel_partisan_guerilla.lore: Industrial mining mobile suit modified with heavy rock-cutters to fight corporate security forces.
ms_rebel_partisan_guerilla.historical_lore: Frontier Militia Partisan was manufactured by Frontier Free Assembly to fill the critical role of Improvised Mining Guerrilla. Assembled in clandestine asteroid hollows by the Asteroid Reclamation Guild. Designed to outlast corporate attrition, its frame features asymmetrical slag armor plates and heavy pneumatic harpoon winches designed for boarding raids and piracy.
ms_rebel_partisan_guerilla.manufacturing_quirks: Ammunition feed chutes for the heavy flak cannons tend to jam if low-grade non-standard propellant rounds are loaded under high-g maneuvers.
ms_rebel_partisan_guerilla.battlefield_reputation: Mercenaries nickname it 'The Junkyard Dog'—ugly, loud, and vicious, with an uncanny ability to keep crawling forward after losing half its torso armor.
ms_rebel_partisan_guerilla.doctrine_summary: Improvised Mining Guerrilla doctrine tailored for faction_c strategic objectives.

ms_rebel_partisan_striker.name: Frontier Vanguard Striker
ms_rebel_partisan_striker.lore: Frontier insurgent machine built from converted ore haulers, armed with jury-rigged mining rockets.
ms_rebel_partisan_striker.historical_lore: Frontier Vanguard Striker was manufactured by Frontier Free Assembly to fill the critical role of Improvised Rocket Skirmisher. Engineered by the Ceres Iron Outlaws as an intimidating shock-assault platform. With dual rotary flak cannons and spiked kinetic ramming cowls, it excels at terrorizing civilian trade convoys and ambushing corporate supply lines.
ms_rebel_partisan_striker.manufacturing_quirks: The scavenged reactor runs hot and loud, occasionally venting caustic sulfurous exhaust directly past the cockpit intake filters.
ms_rebel_partisan_striker.battlefield_reputation: Feared by merchant convoy captains across the Sol system; the harsh shriek of its pneumatic boarding harpoon usually signals total cargo confiscation.
ms_rebel_partisan_striker.doctrine_summary: Improvised Rocket Skirmisher doctrine tailored for faction_c strategic objectives.

ms_pirate_corsair_marauder.name: Outer Ring Corsair Marauder
ms_pirate_corsair_marauder.lore: Notorious pirate boarding machine designed to pierce freighter hulls and harvest element cargo.
ms_pirate_corsair_marauder.historical_lore: Outer Ring Corsair Marauder was manufactured by Outer Ring Pirate Fleets to fill the critical role of Boarding Raider. Engineered by the Ceres Iron Outlaws as an intimidating shock-assault platform. With dual rotary flak cannons and spiked kinetic ramming cowls, it excels at terrorizing civilian trade convoys and ambushing corporate supply lines.
ms_pirate_corsair_marauder.manufacturing_quirks: Asymmetrical scrap plating creates an off-center center-of-gravity; pilots must learn to compensate for a persistent leftward yaw during boost maneuvers.
ms_pirate_corsair_marauder.battlefield_reputation: Terran and Colony militaries officially designate it as 'Irregular Terror Armor', advising pilots to destroy them on sight rather than negotiate.

ms_ancient_derelict_sentry.name: Precursor Derelict Sentry-00
ms_ancient_derelict_sentry.lore: Mysterious autonomous sentry recovered from an uncharted deep-space derelict station.
ms_ancient_derelict_sentry.historical_lore: Precursor Derelict Sentry-00 was manufactured by Unknown Precursor to fill the critical role of Autonomous Ancient Sentinel. Engineered in the high-security orbital labs of Olympus Mons by Hyperion Advanced Tactical Systems. Created to enforce corporate dominance through ruthless surgical precision, the suit integrates bio-neural cockpit synchronization, sub-zero liquid nitrogen coolant loops, and high-frequency tachyon blade weaponry.
ms_ancient_derelict_sentry.manufacturing_quirks: Sub-zero liquid nitrogen cooling jackets frost over the external armor seams, creating a ghostly white mist during high-output blade ignition.
ms_ancient_derelict_sentry.battlefield_reputation: Corporate pilots regard piloting one as the pinnacle of military prestige, treating their chassis with the ritual reverence of an ancestral samurai blade.
ms_ancient_derelict_sentry.doctrine_summary: Autonomous Ancient Sentinel doctrine tailored for faction_d strategic objectives.

ms_apex_apocalypse_harvester.name: Apex Apocalypse Harvester
ms_apex_apocalypse_harvester.lore: Apocalyptic super-weapon mecha created by unshackled bio-neural research, capable of harvesting planetary crusts.
ms_apex_apocalypse_harvester.historical_lore: Apex Apocalypse Harvester was manufactured by Forbidden Cyber-Foundry to fill the critical role of Planetary Siege Leviathan. Designed by Ural Defense Dynamics as a counter to agile zero-gravity Colony incursions. The chassis integrates reinforced recoil dampeners and heavy kinetic armor plating, sacrificing top-speed maneuverability for unyielding structural integrity.
ms_apex_apocalypse_harvester.manufacturing_quirks: Coolant lines in the hip joints are prone to freezing in sub-zero lunar or Siberian conditions, requiring grease monkeys to pre-heat the limbs with plasma torches before morning sorties.
ms_apex_apocalypse_harvester.battlefield_reputation: Pilots nickname its cockpit 'The Iron Sarcophagus' because surviving a direct hit often leaves the hatches warped shut until extraction teams torch them open.
ms_apex_apocalypse_harvester.doctrine_summary: Planetary Siege Leviathan doctrine tailored for faction_a strategic objectives.
